tasks.title: Research: OpenCode vs Claude Code Architecture
tasks.description: Research and document OpenCode's agent system vs Claude Code
tasks.details: Conduct comprehensive research to understand differences between Claude Code and OpenCode agent architectures. Study OpenCode's documentation at https://opencode.ai/docs/agents to understand: 1) Two agent types (primary agents and subagents), 2) Two built-in primary agents (Build, Plan), 3) Two built-in subagents (General, Explore), 4) Agent configuration via JSON and Markdown formats, 5) Permission system with allow/ask/deny levels. Create compatibility matrix showing which features from everything-claude-code can work directly, need adaptation, or are impossible in OpenCode.

tasks.title: Convert Agent System for OpenCode
tasks.description: Convert Claude Code agents to OpenCode format
tasks.details: Convert all 12 specialized agents from everything-claude-code/agents/ directory to OpenCode-compatible format. For each agent: 1) Create markdown agent definition in ~/.config/opencode/agents/ or .opencode/agents/, 2) Map Claude Code's agent-specific tools to OpenCode's permission system (write, edit, bash, grep, ls, view), 3) Set appropriate mode (subagent for most, primary for Build/Plan equivalents), 4) Configure model assignment or inherit from primary agent, 5) Create agent descriptions explaining purpose and when to use. Priority agents: planner, architect, tdd-guide, code-reviewer, security-reviewer.

tasks.title: Convert Skills to Agent Skills
tasks.description: Convert skills to OpenCode Agent Skills format
tasks.details: Convert all 14+ skills from skills/ directory to OpenCode's Agent Skills format (SKILL.md). For each skill: 1) Extract existing skill content and instructions, 2) Create SKILL.md format with frontmatter (description, mode, model, temperature, tools), 3) Adapt tool permissions to match OpenCode's format, 4) Place in ~/.config/opencode/skills/ (global) and .opencode/skills/ (project), 5) Ensure skill discovery works via OpenCode's skills_paths configuration. Priority skills: coding-standards, backend-patterns, frontend-patterns, iterative-retrieval.

tasks.title: Adapt Commands for OpenCode
tasks.description: Adapt Claude Code commands for OpenCode
tasks.details: Adapt 20+ commands from commands/ directory for OpenCode compatibility. Since OpenCode doesn't have native slash commands: 1) Analyze each command's purpose and input parameters, 2) Convert to OpenCode-compatible prompts or create as custom commands via OpenCode's configuration system, 3) Document manual invocation methods (typing prompts instead of slash commands), 4) Create command reference documentation for users. Key commands to prioritize: /plan, /tdd, /code-review, /verify, /orchestrate.

tasks.title: Convert Rules and Contexts
tasks.description: Convert rules and contexts to OpenCode format
tasks.details: Convert rules/ (6 files) and contexts/ (10+ files) to OpenCode's agent-based system. Since OpenCode lacks equivalent to rules/contexts: 1) Extract rule patterns and convert to agent prompt modifications, 2) Map context files to OpenCode's AGENTS.md initialization file, 3) Create guidance for rule enforcement via agent system prompts, 4) Implement workarounds for missing always-follow functionality.

tasks.title: Create Hooks Equivalent System
tasks.description: Create hooks equivalent system for OpenCode
tasks.details: Design and implement alternative mechanisms for Claude Code's event-driven hook system. Since OpenCode doesn't have built-in hooks: 1) Document OpenCode's session management features for memory persistence, 2) Create manual workflows for memory save/load using OpenCode's capabilities, 3) Implement user-initiated compaction patterns as prompts, 4) Create guide for session-based context preservation across OpenCode sessions.

tasks.title: Adapt Advanced Patterns
tasks.details: Create manual implementations for everything-claude-code's advanced patterns since OpenCode cannot natively support them: 1) Iterative Retrieval pattern - create manual 4-phase retrieval guide (dispatch, evaluate, refine, loop), 2) Continuous Learning system - document manual observation and pattern extraction workflow, 3) Sequential/Parallel Agent Orchestration - use OpenCode's multi-session capability with coordination documentation. Create pattern libraries and user guides for manual implementation.

tasks.title: Migrate Scripts and Utilities
tasks.description: Migrate scripts and utilities for OpenCode
tasks.details: Audit and adapt all scripts in scripts/ directory for OpenCode compatibility: 1) Identify dependencies on Claude Code APIs, 2) Create OpenCode-compatible alternatives where needed, 3) Ensure scripts work across OpenCode's environment, 4) Create OpenCode-specific scripts where necessary. Cross-platform compatibility should be maintained.

tasks.title: Write Migration Documentation
tasks.details: Create detailed migration guide for users adapting everything-claude-code for OpenCode: 1) Write comprehensive README with installation and setup instructions, 2) Create compatibility matrix as table showing what works, needs adaptation, or impossible, 3) Provide before/after examples for key workflows, 4) Document known limitations and trade-offs, 5) Include troubleshooting section.

tasks.title: Test Converted Agents
tasks.details: Validate all converted agents work correctly in OpenCode: 1) Test agent discovery from configured paths (global and project), 2) Verify each agent loads with correct permissions and configuration, 3) Test agent invocation via @mentioning, 4) Verify tool restrictions work as expected, 5) Test primary agent switching (Tab key).

tasks.title: Test Skills Discovery
tasks.description: Test converted skills discovery and activation
tasks.details: Verify skills work correctly in OpenCode: 1) Test skill discovery from skills_paths configuration, 2) Verify each skill loads with SKILL.md format, 3) Test skill activation via agent context or user requests, 4) Validate skill metadata (description, mode, tools), 5) Test skill tool permissions.

tasks.title: Test Commands and Workflows
tasks.details: Verify commands work correctly in OpenCode environment: 1) Test each converted command's prompt or configuration, 2) Verify manual invocation methods work, 3) Test command outputs produce expected results, 4) Document any issues or edge cases encountered.

tasks.title: Create Compatibility Reference Guide
tasks.details: Create comprehensive reference documentation for developers: 1) Document OpenCode's configuration schema (JSON and Markdown), 2) Provide Agent Skills format examples, 3) Document permission system usage patterns, 4) Include migration best practices and tips, 5) Create troubleshooting guide for common issues.

tasks.title: Prepare Release v2.0.0 (OpenCode Edition)
tasks.description: Prepare release and create example configurations
tasks.details: Final tasks for releasing OpenCode-compatible version: 1) Create example opencode.json configuration file showing migrated agents/skills setup, 2) Create AGENTS.md template for project context initialization, 3) Prepare CHANGELOG documenting migration changes, 4) Tag and document release for version 2.0.0 (OpenCode Edition), 5) Create installation/setup guide specific to OpenCode.
